_comment_deliberately_unlisted: gh pr comment * and gh api */pulls/*/comments * are intentionally absent from both allow and deny — never blanket-denied (that would break the explicit 'comment issue N on the PR' follow-up), never allow-listed either (so the normal permission prompt still gates every single post, on top of the user having to name the finding in chat). See jobs/comment-finding.md.
_comment_deny_branch_D: The allow list only permits `branch -D prismcr/*` (this tool's own namespaced worktree branch). Deliberately no broader `branch -D *` deny entry exists: since deny rules take precedence over allow rules on overlapping matches, a bare `branch -D *` deny would also swallow the narrow allow above. Any other branch-deletion command simply has no matching allow rule and falls back to the harness's default prompt/deny behavior — that absence is the backstop, not an explicit deny.
